correctness.rationale: The directed three-cycle characterization defines the three substituted transitive blocks with three variables because every third block is nonempty. A strict linear order is definable within each block, with arbitrary finite chain lengths expressible using recycled x,y,z names. The exact-size formulas yield an FO3 oriented triple separator. Permanent two-pebble responses exist because every vertex has in/out neighbors. The cyclic orbit and labelled counts follow from Burnside and unique threefold cyclic encoding. Both independent finite test programs have been executed.
